summary: TELA Bio filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing that on October 5, 2026 it received a Nasdaq letter confirming regained compliance with the $1.00 minimum bid price requirement under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5450(a)(1), closing the deficiency matter. No price, stake, premium, board recommendation, or advisor is stated; the notice is a routine listing-compliance update, not a transaction. Shares continue trading on the Nasdaq Global Market under TELA. What to watch: any future bid-price deficiency and potential reverse split, with no deal or arbitrage angle present.
